title: FlashX: Scaling Robotic Experience Reuse for Embodied Agents with CBA-Based NAND Flash
title_zh: FlashX：基于 CBA NAND 闪存的具身智能体经验复用扩展架构
abstract_en: Embodied agents are emerging as a promising paradigm for complex robotic tasks, leveraging Vision-Language-Action (VLA) and World Action Models (WAMs) to generate actions through Diffusion Transformer (DiT)-based iterative denoising. However, existing models often struggle to generalize to out-of-distribution (OOD) environments. We observe that retrieving successful experiences and using them to warm-start denoising enables agents to better adapt to unfamiliar situations while reducing computational overhead. This creates a new opportunity to improve task accuracy and inference efficiency simultaneously, in contrast to conventional acceleration techniques that trade accuracy for computation. However, realizing this opportunity requires scaling experience banks, introducing substantial storage and search overhead that challenges the capacity, bandwidth, and power constraints of edge systems. We propose FlashX, a CMOS Directly Bonded to Array (CBA)-based NAND flash architecture for scalable experience reuse in embodied agents. FlashX exploits CBA's high internal bandwidth for parallel pSLC key search, employing interleaved Compute-in-Flash (CIF) engines to sustain sensing throughput while retaining dense TLC latent storage. Proprioception-aware clustering further reduces search overhead and enables incremental experience acquisition without global reclustering. Evaluations across VLA and WAM workloads demonstrate up to 12.24\%p and 7.43\%p improvements in task success under dense and compute-efficient configurations, respectively. FlashX achieves 2.57$\times$ higher search throughput than the strongest prior NAND search architecture under pSLC sensing, with a further 9.7$\times$ search reduction through clustering. This delivers 1.29--3.95$\times$ end-to-end speedup and 1.12--2.34$\times$ energy efficiency improvement over SSD-based retrieval.
abstract_zh: 具身智能体可借助视觉-语言-动作模型（Vision-Language-Action，VLA）和世界动作模型（World Action Models，WAMs），通过 Diffusion Transformer（DiT）迭代去噪生成动作，但现有模型在分布外（OOD）环境中往往难以泛化。作者发现，检索成功经验并用其初始化去噪，既能帮助智能体适应陌生环境，也能降低推理开销，有别于以精度换取算力节省的常规加速方法。然而，扩大经验库会增加存储和搜索开销，对边缘设备的容量、带宽和功耗构成挑战。为此，作者提出 FlashX，一种采用 CMOS 与存储阵列直接键合（CMOS Directly Bonded to Array，CBA）的 NAND 闪存架构。FlashX 利用 CBA 的高内部带宽并行搜索 pSLC 中的检索键，以交错运行的闪存内计算（Compute-in-Flash，CIF）引擎维持读取吞吐，同时使用 TLC 高密度存储潜在表示。结合本体感知信息的聚类进一步缩小搜索范围，并支持增量加入经验，无需对全库重新聚类。在 VLA 和 WAM 工作负载中，密集配置与计算高效配置的任务成功率分别最高提升 12.24 和 7.43 个百分点。在 pSLC 读取模式下，FlashX 的搜索吞吐达到最强既有 NAND 搜索架构的 2.57 倍，聚类又将搜索量降至原来的约 1/9.7。相比基于 SSD 的检索方案，FlashX 实现了 1.29–3.95 倍的端到端加速，能效达到基线的 1.12–2.34 倍。

利用 CBA 的高内部带宽和交错式 CIF 引擎并行搜索 pSLC 检索键，同时以 TLC 高密度存储潜在表示。
本体感知聚类将搜索量降至原来的约 1/9.7，并支持增量加入经验，无需对全库重新聚类。
密集配置与计算高效配置的任务成功率分别最高提升 12.24 和 7.43 个百分点。
